text: Derived stats now apply the four AC-related characterValues typeIds: 1 = override AC (sets displayed AC outright), 2 = magic bonus, 3 = misc bonus, 4 = override base armor + DEX (replaces the armor/DEX base, shields and other bonuses still apply). A live check on Zenethor matched DDB's displayed AC at 23, 24 with a typeId 3 value of 1, and 23 again after removal. Other characterValues types are still not applied: saving throw overrides/bonuses (38/39/40), skill overrides/bonuses (23/24/25), saving throw/skill proficiency levels (41/26), skill stat overrides (27), notes (9) and entity-level customizations (10 etc.) need their interaction with proficiency/expertise and item state confirmed before they can safely change derived stats, so the tools only list them. Ability scores are not characterValues; bonusStats/overrideStats are written by set_ability_score. TypeId 39 rows with notes like 'Epic item' are saving throw misc bonuses, not AC.
author: Stavros Korokithakis <hi@stavros.io>

text: Observed 2026-10-20: after homebrew item edits (new modifier, description change), game-data/items showed the change within minutes, but a character holding the item (Bearbug) kept the old item definition in character-service for over 1.5 hours (inventory[].definition still had the old modifiers and description). Earlier tests on another character saw changes propagate, but out of order, within minutes. Cause unknown; possibly the character's item snapshot only refreshes on some other trigger. Do not treat a stale get_character as a tool bug without checking game-data/items first.

text: Stavrobot runs this server via npx with a 30 s MCP connect timeout, and plans to pin the per-commit release tarball URL (releases/download/build-<full sha>/dndbeyond-mcp.tgz). Keep the asset name, tag format and the per-push release workflow stable, and keep cold start well under 30 s (about 5 s from the tarball in Oct 2026). The github:#sha path compiled on install and passed 30 s on Stavrobot's host after the homebrew tools commit (e8f2d1f).

text: Rejected ideas for faster cold start (Oct 2026): optionalDependencies for playwright (npm still installs optional deps by default, so no gain; playwright became a devDependency with a lazy import instead); npm-shrinkwrap.json in the tarball (no measurable cold-start gain); publishing to the npm registry (out of scope; the package name dndbeyond-mcp is unpublished there).

text: Measured with npm 11.19.1: npx -y github:owner/repo#<full 40-char sha> clones, installs and runs prepare four times (about 38 s for this repo), while a short sha does it once (16 to 18 s). Prefer the release tarball; if the github: form is needed, pin a short sha.
